top_retrieved_context.snippet: IND Andrew Nembhard (SG) Out (Injury Management): The Pacers have listed Nembhard as OUT for Monday's (Nov. 2) game against the Hawks.
IND Aaron Nesmith (SF) Out (Injury Management): The Pacers have listed Nesmith as OUT for Monday's (Nov. 2) game against the Hawks.
DEN Julian Strawther (SG) Out (Knee): The Nuggets reported on Friday (Oct. 16) that Strawther will be OUT for six weeks due to a knee injury.
PHI Dominick Barlow (SF) Out (Back): The 76ers said on Monday (Oct. 19) Barlow is set to miss at least 2 weeks due to a back injury, per Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com.
BOS Devin Carter (PG) Out (Illness): Carter has been diagnosed with mononucleosis and is without a timetable for a return, Gary Washburn of The Boston Globe.
MIN Donte DiVincenzo (SG) Out (Achilles): DiVincenzo said on Monday (Oct. 5) that he remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, per Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic.
ORL Jonathan Isaac (PF) Out (Knee): Isaac's latest knee setback is unfortunate, but it's encouraging that he's progressing through rehab and remains confident he'll return this season.

GSW Jimmy Butler III (SF) Out (Knee): The Warriors said on Friday (Oct. 16) that Butler could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, per Anthony Slater of ESPN.
